question: Can an end-to-end spatial plan-selector architecture inspect exact native completed-turn candidates within the validated replanned three-turn teacher's per-action CPU budget? This measures representation plumbing and runtime only; no selector is trained.

fixed_window.states_per_map: The first live decision of each active seat during exact replanned-native self-play, at most two sampled states per map

teacher: Native replanned three-turn root beam256/top8, opponent full-turn beam64, root followup beam32, maximum24 actions per turn, called at every atomic decision
candidate_interface: At each sampled exact game state, request native beam256 top8 distinct completed root-turn plans. Fork and replay every indexed plan, verify each action legal and its native static score exact, then batch the genuine root and nonterminal post-turn observations through the frozen routed-v6 spatial encoder. Preserve the actual active player in every observation; a later selector would receive root seat separately. Terminal candidates are counted separately for a future exact terminal override. No model scores or labels are used to choose game actions.
measurements: Per sampled state: exact teacher-search wall seconds, native root-slate wall seconds, candidate-fork/replay wall seconds, batched encoder wall seconds, candidate count, terminal candidate count, exact score-replay mismatches, and selected source model expert. Run teacher and candidate timing on the same state, alternating measurement order by seed parity. Report medians and p95, not a game-strength or general browser-latency estimate.
advance_gate: All 16 seat-map samples available, every candidate action and static score replays exactly, no action-limit censoring, median root-slate-plus-replay-plus-encoder wall time at most 75% of same-state native three-turn-search median, and p95 no greater than same-state teacher p95. A pass permits design of a separately predeclared fit/validation/game experiment; it does not select or promote a policy.
limits: Initial seat decisions may not represent later crowded states. The source encoder is frozen only for this runtime probe; a future end-to-end model would require new architecture, objective, exact fresh fit/calibration/offline/game/final windows, and fresh complete both-seat games versus source and native teacher. Do not tune this gate after seeing outputs or use old inspected windows for training.
compute: SSH server fedora-toolbox scratch only, one CPU15 pinned nice19 with Rayon/BLAS one thread, no GPU or parallel heavy job, bounded tiny result. Preserve remote original repo and other workloads.
